headword: {三人官女|さんにんかんじょ}
gloss: the three court ladies of a hina display

definitions.gloss: the three court ladies of a hina display
definitions.explanation: The set of three ladies-in-waiting on the second tier of a {雛人形|ひなにんぎょう} display, below the imperial couple. They carry sake utensils, and the middle one is seated while the other two stand.

examples.japanese: {二段目|にだんめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三人官女|さんにんかんじょ}です。
examples.english: The second tier is the three court ladies.

examples.japanese: {三人官女|さんにんかんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{座|すわ}っている→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: Only the middle one of the three court ladies is seated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内裏雛|だいりびな}→内裏雛：30615_dairibina⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三人官女|さんにんかんじょ}、さらに⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{五人囃子|ごにんばやし}→五人囃子：30595_goninbayashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Below the imperial pair come the three court ladies, and below them the five musicians.

notes:
Always treated as one set, so the word is used in the singular even though it names three dolls.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三人官女|さんにんかんじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to arrange the three court ladies
- {三人官女|さんにんかんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧: the court-ladies tier
- ⟦{五人囃子|ごにんばやし}→五人囃子：30595_goninbayashi⟧: the five musicians — the set on the tier below

CULTURAL NOTE:
Only larger, multi-tier displays include them; a compact modern display often stops at the imperial pair. The dolls represent the attendants who served at a Heian court wedding.
